rawFindings.title: Local path dependencies are cached and can return stale contents
rawFindings.explanation: This store call now runs for every non-branch resolver, including local file/path dependencies. The resolve cache does not replace an existing cached release; it returns the old cache directory and removes the freshly resolved temp directory. Therefore local package changes that keep the same version/target can be ignored on later fetches.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a non-cacheable check for local sources and skip both cache lookup and `_resolveCache.store` for them, or extend this condition to return `canonicalDir` for local file/path resolvers.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: A local dependency at `/tmp/pkg` has `bower.json` version `1.0.0` and `index.js` containing `old`. After fetching it once, change only `index.js` to `new` and fetch `{source: '/tmp/pkg', target: '*'}` again. The returned canonical directory is the existing resolve-cache entry containing `old`, not the updated local contents.
